Llama 3.2 is here! 🚀

@scale_AI partnered closely to push the limits:

📊 SEAL Evals: Llama 3.2 90B shows big gains—
   +3 in IF
   +5 in Coding
It’s even beating 405B in Spanish!
🤝 Enterprise partnership for custom Llama models
🔧 Data Foundry partnership for RLHF & SFT https://t.co/tkKUVQDBCT

We are entering the 3rd phase of LLM Development.

1st phase was early tinkering, Transformer to GPT-3
2nd phase was scaling
3rd phase is an innovation phase: what breakthroughs beyond o1 get us to a new proto-AGI paradigm

data.text:
SEAL evaluations are expert, private assessments that update periodically. Stay tuned as the competition heats up and the leaderboard evolves!
 Full breakdown: https://t.co/10nk53b4hj

🚀 SEAL Leaderboard Update 🚀

OpenAI’s o1 is dominating SEAL rankings!

🥇 o1-preview is dominating across key categories:
- #1 in Agentic Tool Use (Enterprise)
- #1 in Instruction Following
- #1 in Spanish

👑 o1-mini leads the charge in Coding https://t.co/z89A6B9Mlq
RT @amitkjolly: $1B ARR far earlier than expected this year and grew 4x year-over-year 👀
RT @garrytan: $1B ARR and 4x YoY 👀
@ericvishria jason is awesome!

Adding Jason to the team will further accelerate the work of our data foundry, and in turn accelerate the speed of AI advancement. The industry is only getting started, and so are we.

Learn more about Jason’s perspective on joining Scale:
https://t.co/4hyLCcI8Un

Now that the “data wall” is the bottleneck for AI advancement, we plan to scale that wall with a combination of data abundance, frontier data for frontier models, and the most advanced evals for measuring model improvement.

note_tweet.text:
For years now, we have iterated and improved on a new business model combining the best capabilities of software and human talent, to provide abundant and high quality data for AI.

The team’s hard work has been paying off; we hit nearly $1B ARR far earlier than expected this year and grew 4x year-over-year.

It’s a true testament to the power of remarkable people equipped with high ownership and high conviction.
